issue.title: [DPB] swss docker crashes when doing DPB in DellEMC Z9332f

failure.body:
#### Description

- swss docker exits in DellEMC Z9332f platform when doing DPB from 1x100G(4) to 4x100G mode.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Load latest master image.
2. Breakout the default 1x400G mode to 1x100G(4) and save the config
3. Breakout 1x100G(4) to 4x100G mode and observe swss docker exits.

                    ],

                        "etp1b"
                    ],
                    "4x100G[50G]": [

                        "etp1b",
                        "etp1c",
                        "etp1d"
                    ],
                    "1x100G(4)": [

                    ]
                }

resolution.title: [DPB] Remove the optimization logic for delete/add ports.
resolution.description:
#### What I did
Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/9663
#### How I did it
Removed the logic which stopped port deletion when DPB is done
#### How to verify it
[DPB_UT.txt](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/files/10001358/DPB_UT.txt)
